title: Worried doctors urge action on frequent shortages of critical drugs
byline: Madi Chwasta; Jarrod Fankhauser; Joshua Byrd; Cristen Tilley
paragraphs: New ABC analysis has revealed the important medicines that have repeatedly been in shortage, highlighting supply chain weaknesses that could get worse.
If you've never heard of Bicillin L-A, count yourself lucky.
It's a long-lasting penicillin and a lifesaver for many Australians with syphilis or rheumatic heart disease.
